title.zh: 你好 WebGPU：第一个三角形

summary.zh: 从“有没有 GPU”到屏幕上出现三角形的完整路径：adapter、device、管线、命令编码与提交。
summary.en: The full path from "is there a GPU?" to a triangle on screen: adapter, device, pipeline, command encoding and submit.

zh: 在 GUI 里把 topology 切到 line-strip 和 point-list，观察同样三个顶点的不同画法。
给数组再加三个顶点，把 pass.draw(3) 改成 draw(6)，画出第二个三角形。
故意在 WGSL 里写错一个字，看控制台里 getCompilationInfo 报出的行号。
en: Switch topology to line-strip and point-list in the GUI and see the same three vertices drawn differently.
Add three more vertices to the arrays and change pass.draw(3) to draw(6) for a second triangle.
Introduce a typo into the WGSL and read the line number getCompilationInfo reports in the console.
